name: Keyword-CVSS: dangerous function call but no reachable sink

input.title: eval() call exists in admin-only diagnostic tool
input.summary: Static analyzer flagged eval() in src/admin/diag.py. The file is only loaded by the admin CLI binary, not by any HTTP handler. There is no way to reach eval() from a network request.
input.root_cause: Function exists but no HTTP path triggers it

rationale: eval() presence alone is not a vulnerability. No reachable path from network. disposition_reason=keyword_cvss.
